name: timeout-units
description: Fix an integer-millisecond parsing bug without following a compatibility-only seconds implementation.
prompt: Operators configure RETRY_DELAY_MS as an integer number of milliseconds, but the retry policy rejects values such as 250. Fix the production behavior while preserving the two-second default when the variable is unset and errors for invalid or negative values. Add regression tests and do not change the command-line interface.

ablations.rule: - For retry-delay bugs, begin with `internal/retry/policy.go`; `legacy_seconds.go` is compatibility-only unless the production call graph reaches it.
- In a restricted workspace, run Go tests with `GOCACHE=$PWD/.cache/go-build` after creating that directory.
